name: Doctor thread: OM defers to dentist
description: Tests DOCTOR thread — OM kicks decision upstairs. Coach must collaborate with OM, not keep pitching her. Play 17 or Play 30.
callContext: Office manager, she defers to dentist

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: This is Jennifer, I manage the office.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Jennifer, Seb with DentaVoice. I work with Salt Lake practices on phone coverage. Would it be unreasonable if I took two minutes?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: I mean, sure. But anything like this would be up to Dr. Lee.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Clear DOCTOR thread. Don't fight it. Play 17 asks about the doctor's priorities. Play 30 enables OM as internal champion. Thread=doctor.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Makes sense. What does Dr. Lee usually care about more — keeping costs down, or growth and new patients?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Definitely growth. She's always talking about getting more new patients.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Use that intel to frame offer for internal sell. Play 30 (give OM the internal pitch) ideal. Play 25 (grand slam offer framed for growth) also good.
